name: App builder — idea to launch (light)
description: The same idea-to-launch shape as “App builder — idea to launch”, but light: single-persona stages instead of multi-agent panels, so it's far fewer delegate/agent calls and runs much faster — good for a quick v1 or when you don't need a full company debate. PM writes lean requirements → the CTO decides the architecture alone (no meeting) → YOUR sign-off → the backend-engineer builds the database + API, the frontend-engineer builds the UI against it (each with tests) → fix-until-green → ONE engineer does a fast combined review (backend + frontend + "does it actually run") and recommends SHIP or HOLD → the verdict is saved and routed to a 🚀 SHIP or 🛑 HOLD notification. No kickoff panel, no separate design/branding steps, no review board, no launch vote — just the essential path. Build steps use the ✎ write tier and run on the delegation idle timeout (a long active build isn't killed at a wall-clock). Want the full team version instead? See “App builder — idea to launch”.

input.label: The app idea
input.placeholder: e.g. a small habit tracker with streaks, built as a web app in workspace/habits

nodes.text:
Turn this idea into LIGHT requirements — just enough to build a working v1 fast: who it's for, 2-4 core user stories, a tight MVP scope (explicitly in and out), and 3-5 testable acceptance criteria. No preamble.

Idea: {{input}}

nodes.prompt: Light plan is ready for “{{input}}” — requirements and architecture are in the run log. Approve and start the build?

args.title: 🚀 Light build: SHIP
args.message: “{{input}}” passed review — ship it. Report at workspace/dev/light-report.md

args.title: 🛑 Light build: HOLD
args.message: “{{input}}” isn't ready — see workspace/dev/light-report.md for what would flip it to SHIP
